turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good, good. Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I work on building sites through the winter. What should I buy to stay warm?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Layers beat one big coat. Start with a thermal base layer, ideally merino wool or a synthetic that pulls sweat away.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My teenage son is gaming till two in the morning, then can't get up for school.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Tough one. Would you go for a phone and console free bedroom, or agree a later but firm cutoff time with him?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sorry to bother you, I've got a quick question.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, sorry Moshi, give me a sec.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Which beans did you buy this time?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Some Ethiopian ones. The guy at the market said they're fruity.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fruity coffee? That sounds wrong.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just try it. It tastes a bit like berries, honestly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine. Should I grind them fine or coarse for the pour-over?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Medium, like sand. Not too fine or it gets bitter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Medium, okay. I'll make us both one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ryan, are you back already?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, the store was quick.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, okay, I'm back. Let's hear it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. The two in the morning gaming. Screens out of the bedroom, or a cutoff?
